description: Source code for a JUnit test report generator class used in Playwright testing framework, handling XML report creation, test suite aggregation, and output formatting.

classes.name: JUnitReporter
classes.description: Implements a test reporter that generates JUnit XML reports for Playwright test results.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the JUnitReporter with options, setting environment-based flags and output file resolution.

methods.name: printsToStdio
methods.description: Indicates whether the reporter outputs directly to stdout.

methods.name: onBegin
methods.description: Marks the start of a test suite run, recording timestamp.

methods.name: onEnd
methods.description: Generates and outputs the final XML report after test execution completes.

methods.name: _buildTestSuite
methods.description: Builds an XML entry for a test suite, aggregating test case results.

methods.name: _addTestCase
methods.description: Creates an XML entry for an individual test case, including properties and outcomes.

methods.name: _addFailureEntry
methods.description: Adds failure or error details to a test case XML entry.

methods.name: _appendStdIO
methods.description: Appends stdout and stderr outputs, including attachments, to a test case XML entry.

methods.name: _buildRetryEntry
methods.description: Builds an XML entry for a test retry (flaky or rerun).
